opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000; will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel up to £2,000/£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK-originating projects apply to UK office; Japan-originating to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible, bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000; continuing projects up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Health and medical professionals, researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in Japan and the UK. Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
